subject.title: [Security] Subagent environment variable inheritance leak in host execution mode

question: Should host-workspace subagent execution receive a reduced, explicitly constructed environment by default, and which runtime credentials are permitted in that contract?
rationale: The intended trust boundary for host-mode subagent code and the acceptable set of inherited credentials are product-security choices that cannot safely be inferred from the issue alone.

options.title: Adopt a minimal explicit environment
options.body: Construct the host worker environment from documented runtime requirements and add regression coverage showing unrelated parent secrets are absent.

options.title: Keep inheritance with documented trusted-host scope
options.body: Retain parent-environment inheritance only if maintainers explicitly define host-mode subagents as trusted and document the resulting secret boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt a minimal explicit environment
recommendation.body: Construct the host worker environment from documented runtime requirements and add regression coverage showing unrelated parent secrets are absent.

likelyOwner.reason: The only identified participant supplied the concrete suspected execution boundary; a source-history owner should be added after the relevant files are inspected.
